name: Smart Farming AI Agent
description: An AI Agent for Smart Farming Advice powered by RAG and IBM Granite. Delivers real-time, localized agricultural guidance to small-scale farmers including weather forecasts, soil conditions, crop recommendations, pest control measures, and current mandi market prices.

problem_statement.title: AI Agent for Smart Farming Advice

agents.name: Weather & Forecast Agent
agents.description: Retrieves real-time weather forecasts and provides crop-specific advisories

agents.name: Soil & Crop Advisory Agent
agents.description: Analyzes soil conditions and recommends crops based on season and region

agents.name: Pest Control Agent
agents.description: Provides pest management strategies from trusted agricultural sources

agents.name: Market Price Agent
agents.description: Delivers live mandi rates for crops from Agmarknet

features: Multilingual farmer interaction in regional Indian languages
RAG-based real-time data retrieval for accuracy
IBM Granite for natural language understanding and generation
Pest control guidance with organic and chemical remedies
